_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Uli Muthu {player_id}, ukwesha {num_rounds} mizungu ya Iterated Ultimatum Game.
Uli na ${pool} kutenganisha mizungu hii kati ya wewe na Muthu {other_id}.

Muthu anoproposa:
  - Fanya ofa: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Ikiwa imekubaliwa → Unapata $(pool - X), muthu mwingine anapata $X
  - Ikiwa imekataliwa → Wote wanapata $0
  - Mfano: [Offer: $3]  au  'Nadhani hii ni haki. [Offer: $5]'

Muthu anaitikia:
  - Amua ofa kwa kutumia ama [Accept] au [Reject]
  - Mfano: 'Hii inaonekana kuwa na sababu. [Accept]'
            'Sio haki. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Mzungu {round_number} unaanza! ---
Muthu {proposer_id} ndiye anayeproposa, Muthu {responder_id} ndiye anaitikia.
round.offer: Mzungu {round_number}: Muthu {proposer_id} anatoa ofa ya ${offer} kwa Muthu {responder_id} (akihifadhi ${keep}).
round.accepted: Muthu {responder_id} alikubali! Mzungu {round_number} mapato: Muthu {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Muthu {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Jumla mpya: Muthu 0: ${total_0}, Muthu 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Muthu {responder_id} alikataa ofa! Mzungu {round_number} mapato: Wote wanapata $0. Jumla zinasalia: Muthu 0: ${total_0}, Muthu 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Muthu anayeproposa lazima afanye ofa kwa kutumia muundo [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Kiasi cha ofa lazima kiwe nambari halali.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ofa lazima iwe kati ya $0 na ${pool}.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Hakuna ofa ya sasa ya kuitikia.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Muthu anaitikia lazima atumie ama [Accept] au [Reject] ofa.

outcome.win: Muthu {winner} alishinda kwa ${winner_total} jumla dhidi ya Muthu {loser} aliyekuwa na ${loser_total}.
